subject: [RFC PATCH 46/57] mm/khugepaged: scan under a per-VMA read lock

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch modifies the khugepaged functionality to take a per-VMA read lock instead of holding the mmap_lock for the whole address space walk. This change allows multiple scans to run concurrently, improving performance. The patch also updates the cursor movement and error handling mechanisms to accommodate the new locking scheme.
